articles.summary: CLEVELAND, Feb. 8 – Milder temperatures bring with it the potential for an increase in scam activity door-to-door, by phone or via text. Dominion Energy is reminding customers to stay vigilant in the face of the upcoming changing seasons. “Scammers never seem to take a day off. We continually hear about new ways scammers are approaching our customers to get their sensitive information,” said Bob Metzinger , general manager of Customer Service at Dominion Energy Ohio . “It’s important for everyone in our service area to understand how we work with our customers so they can keep their information safe and help stop these criminals.” Know the warning signs of a utility scam: Dominion Energy will never demand payment with a credit or debit card by phone or ask a customer to wire a transfer, send a money order or buy a prepaid or gift card to pay a utility bill. Dominion Energy does not call and threaten service disconnection if a customer does not make a payment immediately.
articles.title: Protect Yourself: Dominion Energy Shares Signs of Utility Scams as Spring Approaches
